## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and the Runtime or engine boundary affected.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Ran the relevant .NET, Godot, Unity, package, or privacy gates.
- [ ] Updated wire, compatibility notes, examples, and documentation where required.
- [ ] Updated both English and Chinese READMEs when a shared product fact changed.
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, private material, generated engine state, or proprietary assets are included.
- [ ] Documented breaking changes and migration steps.

## Authority and recovery review

- [ ] Game-owned validation and authoritative mutation remain in game code.
- [ ] Side effects have stable operation IDs, durable intent, and explicit receipts.
- [ ] Cancellation, timeout, retry, crash recovery, and uncertain outcomes remain bounded and safe.
- [ ] New callbacks, collections, queues, payloads, and concurrent work have explicit limits.

If an item does not apply, explain why in the summary instead of checking it
without evidence.
